notes: Yamamoto-first discovery pass under the current durable editorial authority. docs/PRIORITIES.md, docs/EDITORIAL.md, docs/DOMAINS.md, and radar/inbox/README.md were read before research and grading. Repository-wide duplicate searches were run for each proposed artist/date/venue. Stage 1 admitted six performances for specific live-context reasons rather than artist fame alone. Stage 2 produces A 1 / A+ 4 / S 1 / S+ 0. Recent curated intake remains weighted toward A and A+, with scarcity tiers rare; the single S received a second editorial challenge because Kawasaki Shimin Plaza explicitly identifies the October 3 program as the final performance of a roughly five-year Plaza Afternoon Jazz series, with a one-off two-part bill pairing Masahiko Sato's trio plus Keisuke Ohta and Tsuyoshi Yamamoto's Kagawa/Osumi trio plus Takuya Osumi. A+ would understate the final-series context; S+ would overstate its broader historical singularity. No automated self-check is represented as independent human or Codex review.

events.artist: Masahiko Sato Trio featuring Keisuke Ohta / Tsuyoshi Yamamoto Trio + Takuya Osumi
events.subtitle: Plaza Afternoon Jazz Vol.21 FINAL
events.category: Japanese jazz masters / series finale / special double-bill
events.factual_description: Kawasaki Shimin Plaza presents Plaza Afternoon Jazz Vol.21 FINAL on October 3, 2026, with doors at 13:30 and the performance at 14:00 in the Furusato Theater. The presenter describes it as the final performance of a Plaza Afternoon Jazz series held for roughly five years. Part 1 is Masahiko Sato Trio featuring violinist Keisuke Ohta, with Hideaki Kanazawa on bass and Shun Ishiwaka on drums. Part 2 is Tsuyoshi Yamamoto on piano with Hiroshi Kagawa on bass and Toshio Osumi on drums, expanded by Takuya Osumi on alto saxophone.

enrichment.note: The presenter event page and authoritative Kanagawa tourism listing verify the date, time, venue, final-series context and full announced personnel. The event page states that web/front-desk/telephone sales are available, but no exact standalone purchase destination or Apple Music destination is supplied without verification.

sources.note: Primary presenter page; the official venue calendar also lists the October 3 FINAL event.
Authoritative listing verifies October 3, 13:30 doors / 14:00 start, Furusato Theater, roughly five-year series finale, two-part program and full announced personnel.

provenance.note: Date, venue, time, series-final context and full announced lineup were verified from Kawasaki Shimin Plaza and Kanagawa's official tourism listing. Repository searches for the title and Yamamoto plus Kawasaki on October 3 returned no existing RADAR match before publication.

en.why_it_matters: This is not simply another Yamamoto club date. Kawasaki closes a roughly five-year jazz series with a deliberately built two-part finale: Masahiko Sato's trio widened by Keisuke Ohta's violin, then Yamamoto's current Kagawa/Osumi rhythm section widened by Takuya Osumi on alto. The final-series setting and exact double-bill give the afternoon a live context that cannot recur as another installment.
en.trip_verdict: If October 3 overlaps with Greater Tokyo or Kanto, protect the afternoon and build the day around Kawasaki. The reason to go is the series-ending program and the exact pair of ensembles, not Yamamoto's name by itself.

es.why_it_matters: No es simplemente otra fecha de club de Yamamoto. Kawasaki cierra una serie de jazz de aproximadamente cinco años con un final construido en dos partes: el trío de Masahiko Sato ampliado por el violín de Keisuke Ohta y, después, la sección Kagawa/Osumi de Yamamoto ampliada por el alto de Takuya Osumi. El cierre de la serie y este doble cartel exacto le dan a la tarde un contexto en vivo que ya no puede repetirse como otra entrega.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 3 de octubre coincide con una estancia en Greater Tokyo o Kanto, protegería la tarde y armaría el día alrededor de Kawasaki. La razón para ir es el cierre de la serie y esta combinación exacta de ensambles, no el nombre de Yamamoto por sí solo.

priority_review.rationale: Concrete scarcity: the presenter identifies this as the FINAL of a roughly five-year series, and the closing program is a one-off two-part bill with two specified expanded ensembles. The editorial challenge asked whether A+ would still capture the recommendation; it would understate the genuine regret of missing the series-ending installment. S+ was rejected because the event is not singular or historically exceptional enough to justify altering plans at that level.

events.subtitle: BIOMES — Album Release
events.category: Electro-acoustic new music / album release / world-premiere program
events.factual_description: Roulette presents Katherine Young's BIOMES album-release performance on September 17, 2026 at 8:00 PM, with doors at 7:00 PM. The program includes Yarn/Wire performing Young's BIOMES 6.0, a world premiere by Olivia Block and Young using tape machines, and improvisations by Ben LaMar Gay, Brian Chase and Young. The announced personnel are Young on electronics and bassoon, Block on electronics, Gay on cornet, Chase on percussion, and Yarn/Wire members Laura Barger and Julia Den Boer on piano plus Dustin Donahue and Russell Greenberg on percussion.

enrichment.note: Roulette verifies the announced program, personnel, date/time and authorized AudienceView ticket destination. No exact Apple Music destination is supplied without verification.

sources.note: Primary event page verifies the album release, 8:00 PM performance, world-premiere Block/Young work, improvisation set and full announced personnel.
Authorized exact purchase destination linked by Roulette.

provenance.note: Date, time, venue, program structure, world-premiere element, personnel and authorized ticket destination were verified from Roulette. Repository search for Katherine Young BIOMES on September 17 returned no existing RADAR event before publication.

en.why_it_matters: The bassoon is the center of gravity rather than an orchestral color: Young uses it with electronics, tape, two pianos and percussion to make an electro-acoustic environment, then opens the frame further through improvisation with Ben LaMar Gay and Brian Chase. The album release also carries a new Block/Young tape-machine work, so the night has a concrete compositional and instrumental argument beyond a generic new-music bill.
en.trip_verdict: If Brooklyn is already in play on September 17, this is worth catching and can give the evening a strong experimental anchor. From farther down the corridor, I would pair it with another New York reason rather than build the whole trip around this date alone.

es.why_it_matters: Aquí el fagot funciona como centro de gravedad y no como simple color orquestal: Young lo cruza con electrónica, cinta, dos pianos y percusión para construir un entorno electroacústico, y después abre todavía más el marco con improvisaciones junto a Ben LaMar Gay y Brian Chase. El lanzamiento del disco suma además una obra nueva de Block y Young con máquinas de cinta, así que la noche tiene un argumento compositivo e instrumental concreto más allá de una cartelera genérica de música nueva.
es.trip_verdict: Si Brooklyn ya está en juego el 17 de septiembre, vale la pena entrar y puede darle a la noche un ancla experimental muy buena. Desde más lejos en el corredor, la combinaría con otra razón para estar en Nueva York en vez de construir todo el viaje alrededor de esta fecha.

The official page describes her live approach in terms of unpredictable arrangements and audience dialogue, and identifies Nakamura on voice and piano.

en.why_it_matters: The specific hook is the format: the second Tokyo day is the only solo performance on Nakamura's first Billboard Live tour. Voice and piano put her unpredictable rearranging and audience-responsive phrasing in the foreground, stripping away the band architecture used on the surrounding dates and making the live decision-making itself the point.
en.trip_verdict: If Tokyo is in play on October 12, actively make room for one of the two sets and let the solo format determine the choice. Its uniqueness inside this tour makes it worth prioritizing locally, without pretending that a solo Nakamura performance can never happen again.

es.why_it_matters: El gancho concreto es el formato: el segundo día de Tokio es la única presentación solista de la primera gira de Nakamura por Billboard Live. Voz y piano dejan al frente sus reacomodos impredecibles y su manera de responder al público, quitando la arquitectura de banda de las fechas vecinas y convirtiendo la toma de decisiones en vivo en el centro de la noche.
es.trip_verdict: Si Tokio está en juego el 12 de octubre, le haría espacio activamente a uno de los dos sets y escogería pensando precisamente en el formato solista. Su singularidad dentro de esta gira justifica priorizarla estando allá, sin fingir que una presentación solista de Nakamura no pueda volver a ocurrir.

events.subtitle: John Scofield with Adam Deitch, Larry Goldings and Oteil Burbridge
events.factual_description: The Hamilton Live's authorized EVENTIM page lists John Scofield's Electrospective for October 22, 2026, with doors at 18:30 and the show at 20:00. The announced band is Scofield with Adam Deitch on drums, Larry Goldings on keyboards and Oteil Burbridge on bass. The event is framed as a career look back at Scofield's fusion-groove writing, drawing from the Blue Matter, Uberjam and A Go Go bands along with new material in the same vein.

enrichment.note: The Hamilton's authorized EVENTIM page verifies the date, doors, showtime, complete quartet, repertoire framing and active purchase destination. No exact Apple Music destination is supplied without verification.

en.why_it_matters: Electrospective is a repertoire decision, not a generic Scofield booking: he is reopening the fusion-and-groove side of his catalog with a band built to bend it rather than reproduce old arrangements. Deitch, Goldings and Burbridge give the material a rhythm-section identity strong enough to make Blue Matter, Uberjam and A Go Go function as raw material again instead of nostalgia.
en.trip_verdict: This is local enough to make room for without turning it into corridor logistics. If October 22 is open, let the 8:00 PM set anchor the DC night; there is no reason to chase another city for the same project unless the Washington date conflicts.
en.listen_before: Blue Matter; A Go Go; Überjam

es.why_it_matters: Electrospective es una decisión de repertorio, no una contratación genérica de Scofield: vuelve a abrir el lado fusion y groove de su catálogo con una banda hecha para doblar ese material, no para reproducir arreglos viejos. Deitch, Goldings y Burbridge le dan una identidad rítmica suficientemente fuerte para que Blue Matter, Uberjam y A Go Go vuelvan a funcionar como materia prima en vez de nostalgia.
es.trip_verdict: Es lo bastante local como para hacerle espacio sin convertirlo en logística de corredor. Si el 22 de octubre está libre, dejaría que el set de las 8:00 PM ordene la noche en DC; no hay razón para perseguir otra ciudad con el mismo proyecto salvo que Washington choque con algo más fuerte.
es.listen_before: Blue Matter; A Go Go; Überjam

events.subtitle: Mutual Mentorship for Musicians — 5th annual in-person festival
events.factual_description: Roulette hosts the fifth annual in-person M³ Festival on November 7, 2026 at 7:00 PM, with doors at 6:30 PM. Mutual Mentorship for Musicians, created by Jen Shyu and Sara Serpa, is described as a non-hierarchical mentorship platform centered on cross-generational collaborative commissions. The announced 2026 lineup spans 32 composer-performers, including Terri Lyne Carrington, William Parker, Theo Bleckmann, Martha Redbone, Marta Sanchez, Caroline Davis, Stephan Crump, Tomas Fujiwara and Yuhan Su among the full published roster.

enrichment.note: Roulette verifies the date/time, fifth-annual context, full published lineup and M³'s collaborative-commission model. Roulette states that tickets will be made available through the M³ homepage; no exact purchase destination or Apple Music destination is supplied here until verified.

sources.note: Primary event page verifies November 7 at 7:00 PM, 6:30 PM doors, fifth annual festival, full 32-name lineup, and Mutual Mentorship for Musicians' non-hierarchical collaborative-commission model.

provenance.note: Date, time, venue, festival edition, full announced lineup and curatorial model were verified from Roulette. Repository search for M3 Festival at Roulette on November 7 returned no existing RADAR event before publication.

en.why_it_matters: The curatorial mechanism is the event: M³ is built around non-hierarchical, cross-generational mentorship and collaborative commissions rather than a sequence of unrelated festival sets. A roster that places Terri Lyne Carrington and William Parker in the same ecosystem as Marta Sanchez, Caroline Davis, Tomas Fujiwara, Yuhan Su and a much wider field of composer-performers makes the night a snapshot of how New York creative music is transmitting ideas across generations.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is viable that Saturday, actively make room for Roulette and let the festival anchor the Brooklyn portion of the day. It is substantial enough to shape an overnight or weekend when another New York reason shares the trip, while the annual format keeps it from being treated as a one-time historical event.

es.why_it_matters: El mecanismo curatorial es el evento: M³ está construido alrededor de mentoría no jerárquica, cruces generacionales y comisiones colaborativas, no como una sucesión de sets desconectados. Una lista que coloca a Terri Lyne Carrington y William Parker en el mismo ecosistema que Marta Sanchez, Caroline Davis, Tomas Fujiwara, Yuhan Su y un campo mucho más amplio de compositores-intérpretes vuelve la noche una fotografía de cómo la música creativa de Nueva York transmite ideas entre generaciones.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York es viable ese sábado, le haría espacio activamente a Roulette y dejaría que el festival ancle la parte de Brooklyn del día. Tiene suficiente peso para ordenar un overnight o un fin de semana si comparte el viaje con otra buena razón en la ciudad, mientras que su formato anual evita tratarlo como un acontecimiento histórico de una sola vez.
